headline: HuyenBao v11.21 — Spirit-tab activities now grant spirit points (capped per day)
summary: Per player request, the four Spirit-tab panels (Kinh Dịch / Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ / Tarot nâng cao) now grant spirit points when a reading completes. Each activity is a contemplation act: Kinh Dịch cast +2, Tử Vi chart +3, Phong Thuỷ analysis +2, Tarot spread +1–3 (1-card → +1, 3-card → +2, 5-card → +3). Capped at SPIRIT_DAILY_CAP=8 points per game-day so the player can't farm spirit by spamming casts — the cap resets when the game-day rolls over. The Spirit tab shows the daily remaining budget inline. Spirit points feed the existing spirit-state system (Restless / Calm / Centered / Enlightened) and unlock the existing perks: spirit ≥ 70 → business ×1.10 + slower aging; spirit ≥ 80 → cosmic ventures ×1.25. 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features unchanged in their reading logic — only a post-reading spirit grant was added.
